description: The Amazon Selling Partner API enables applications to call SP-API on behalf of selling partners after authorization.

evidence.claim: The Amazon Selling Partner API allows applications to call the SP-API on behalf of selling partners after authorization.
Public applications must use OAuth 2.0 through Login with Amazon (LWA) for authorization.
evidence.notes: Specifies OAuth 2.0 required for public apps.

evidence.claim: Private applications can self-authorize using Solution Provider Portal, Seller Central, or Vendor Central.
evidence.notes: Describes self-authorization workflow for private apps.
